Head-sha: 657d8484dd502f99908ae90ff4a9e1ef77734f22
Reviewer: seat 3 L1-c, for #34869 slice 1 (the daily MCP ask round) and the #34764 charter line (claim 6951963481 plus the seat's surface note on #34764; os-dev report 6953905398).

### 席位核对

**PR shape.** Draft, base `main`, `Part of #34869` and `Part of #34764`, with no closing verb. Two paths.

**Governed / size.** `check-governed-merges --pr 34913`: GOVERNED, Tier S, on both paths (`.claude/**` ×2). 52 lines. The route is the seat's fable L2 and its record, then o3-E lands. No changeset is owed, since nothing ships.

**Check-runs at 657d8484, read at about 16:21Z.** 45 runs, none failed. `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` and two other scoped lints are `success`. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` and the four `Type Check ·` legs are still `in_progress`, so `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` have not posted yet. This verdict holds on the condition that they finish green on this head, which o3-E confirms before landing.

**`lanes/eval.md` (45 → 43 lines).**
- ⑤ (the MCP ask round, daily) and ⑥ (the weekly skills-eval round) are added under 评测范围. The cadence line, the 产出 line and the full-scores line follow them.
- I checked the full-scores widening against the maintainer ruling 6946545946 on #34764 (「A 进本仓带全分,同场景卡」). It is worded in the same terms as the scenario-card line, with no issue number, date or quotation, as the ruling's execution note asks.
- The body's correction to the card is right: the line on main already read 「问数基线每天一轮」, so ② is unchanged.

**`scenario-eval/SKILL.md` (+34).** I checked every runner fact the new text states, on this head:
- `assertSubscriptionLogin` (`driver.ts:211`) throws `ApiBillingRefusedError` on either env var or an API-key `authMethod`.
- The card list is read from `grep -l '"datasetQuestions"'`, which gives exactly `order_to_cash` and `travel_expense`.
- One command per card is right: `withInstalledBuild` skips a build whose namespace is not the card's.
- `summary.ts:184`'s `TABLE_DIMENSIONS` include `ask repeats` and `ask skills`, so both "summary refuses to mix" claims hold.
- `requestedModel` and `requestedEffort` are on each turn (`driver.ts:479`/`:506`). `Run · datasets` is a scorecard row (`scorecard.ts:858`). `packagesLine` and the `framework` sha feed the record.
- The leak paragraph matches the code: persona questions go through each persona's own key (`keyOf`), and dataset questions are asked as the admin (`orchestrate.ts` `DatasetQuestionResult` docblock and line 1501), so they never feed a persona leak count.

**Overlap with #34110.** It touches the same SKILL.md. The seat ruled that this PR lands first and noted it on #34110, so #34110 rebases.

### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix
- **S1. The 「问数日轮尚未能跑」 bullet will go stale the day its blockers land, and the seat follows the skill verbatim.**
  - The bullet describes the code in the present tense: 「ask 模式现只做非托管安装 … 尚未落地;落地前日轮不开跑」.
  - Both blockers are open PRs today. The managed-install fallback is #34911 (L1 ACCEPT 6953799345, seat L2 pending). The `asked-back` scoring fix is #34882 (delta ACCEPT 6953092535, landing). Neither is on `main` at the time of this read.
  - Once both merge, the text is false. Unblocking the round would then need another Tier S PR with its own L2 and record, and until that lands, a routine that reads 「落地前日轮不开跑」 does not run.
  - The fix: state the gate as a condition the reader checks, and name the carriers. For example: 「日轮在 #34911(托管安装回退)与 #34882(`asked-back` 评分修正)都合并之后开跑;开跑前查一次两者已合并」. Keep one clause on why (`422 UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE` on `capability` builds) if you want the reason to stay. The line count is unchanged.
  - The same goes for the §4 comment 「(§1:尚未能跑)」.

  Under the current merge standard this gets fixed before landing. I'll take the delta read.

### Notes
- N1. **The 交接 deletion (the dev asks reviewers to veto if the hand-over is still pending).**
  - Two of its three lines duplicate 评测范围: the ② cloud baseline, and ③ and ④ joining the routine when ready.
  - The only unique line is the one-time event 「cloud 场景库专题建完…例行运行移交本席,该专题关闭」.
  - I cannot read the cloud epic's state from this repository, so the seat should judge it in L2. If that epic is still open, keep that one line (44 lines, still under 45). If it is closed, the deletion is right.
- N2. 「对外口径由维护者决定」 goes with the deleted ② line. The general ⛔ line 「不对外发布准确率数字」 still covers ②, so nothing is lost in practice.

Next: o3-E fixes S1, then the L1-c delta read. After that, the seat's fable L2 and record (Tier S), and o3-E lands once Lint and Type Check are green. #34110 rebases after.

Already `success`: `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Type Check · workspace`, `· source gates`, `· debt ledger`, and three scoped lints. Still `in_progress`: `Lint · ESLint`, `· docs & code guards`, `· repo & tooling gates`, `· CI, release & engine gates`, `· PM dispatch-gates` and `Type Check · consumer gates`. ### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix
None.

### Notes
- N1. Under 地盘 the hand-over line reads as territory rather than as a pending event. The 45-line ceiling forbids its own heading, and the line says what it is, so this is acceptable. Once that epic closes, the line can go in the next edit of the file.

Next: the seat's fable L2 and record (Tier S), then o3-E lands once Lint and Type Check are green. #34110 rebases after. A later push owes an L1-c delta read.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2f66ea60018a40ae2db641b2aff8e001c00ff334`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md, .claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md + none

Inputs read: card #34869 (body and all 5 comments), PR #34913 (body, 2-file list, net diff against `main`, both L1-c comments), and the 47 check-runs on this head. The diff holds no implementing file: both paths are rule text, and the code they describe (`packages/qa/scenarios/**`) is outside the diff, so it was read on `main` at 189358f2 and not reviewed. The PR is `clean` against `main`; `main` has not touched either path since the merge base.

Check-runs on this head, all concluded: 23 success, 24 skipped by selector, 0 failed, 0 pending. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and both `PR-body guards` runs are success. The L1-c delta ACCEPT (6954357328) was conditional on the Lint and Type Check lanes finishing green; they have.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: no schema, no validator, no gate and no runner flag changes. Nothing a customer or a package consumer can author or call is widened or narrowed. Right.
- Public surface: none. `.claude/**` ships in no package; `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` keeps `metadata.internal: true`, so it stays out of `npx skills add` discovery. Right.
- Governed surface: `.claude/**` ×2, Tier S; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is success on this head. Right.
- Line ratchet: `lanes/eval.md` is 44 lines against the ceiling of 45 in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (the row is unchanged in this diff), widest line 120 bytes against the 120-byte cap. The ceiling is not raised. `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` has no ratchet row on this head; #34110 adds one and rebases after this lands (seat ruling, recorded on the PR). Right.
- The eval seat's routine set changes in meaning: ⑤ daily and ⑥ weekly join the charter. This PR creates no Routine or trigger; the card says the seat arms it later. Right.
- The full-scores boundary line widens from scenario cards to scenario cards and ⑥. It follows the maintainer's ruling on #34764 as the PR body and the L1-c read cite it (comment 6946545946); the charter line itself carries no issue number, as `check:pm-skill-id-lint` requires for that file. Right.

### ② Semver level

No changeset, label `skip-changeset`: correct, since the diff publishes nothing (two files under `.claude/**`). `Check Changeset` concluded skipped. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim (6951963481) matches: no published accept-set is touched in either direction. `Metadata-protocol: none` matches.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, report 6953417484 `open_questions`: landing order against #34110 on `scenario-eval/SKILL.md`. Answered by the seat (this PR first; #34110 rebases and pins the ceiling at the merged count). The PR body carries the landing-order line. Closed.
- Dev flag, report 6953905398: the request to veto the 交接 deletion if the hand-over is still pending. Answered by the seat's ruling; the cloud scenario-library hand-over line is back on this head, byte-identical to `main`, as line 44. Closed.
- Dev note (out of scope, twice): the card's Evidence calls ② a per-release baseline while `main` already runs it daily. Checked on `main`: line 7 reads 「问数基线每天一轮」 and the cost section repeats it. The diff leaves ②'s cadence unchanged (「节奏照旧」). The correction is right and needs no carrier.
- Card `Blocked-by: #34687`: it gates the daily runs, not this text. The SKILL carries the gate as a start condition (see ④). #34882 merged at 16:27Z today; #34911 is open, so the round does not start yet, which is what the text says.
- Reports 6953905398 and 6954284796 carry empty `open_questions` and `security_findings: none`.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff holds no query, no id materialisation and no join.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md`, against the card's Scope, the SKILL and the runner on `main`:

- ⑤ (lines 16–17) states the card's Scope sentence for sentence: the open runner's ask mode, the cards that carry datasets, local boot, subscription login, no cloud repository; and the two-measurements line (⑤ reads the server side with a general client, ② reads the product's agent, stays the bar and keeps its cadence). Line 7 puts ⑤ on the daily cadence beside ②.
- ⑥ (lines 18–19) agrees with README `skill-evals` on `main` (#34841): cases at `skills/BUNDLE/evals/*.json`, a with-skill and a no-skill arm, the subscription guard. It contradicts nothing in that runner: the README says `skill-evals` is not a CI job and not a merge gate, and the charter makes it a weekly seat routine, not a gate. A with-skill failure reported as a `finding` to `domain:skills` matches line 36 and SKILL §6.
- Line 30 routes ①⑤ through `scenario-eval` and leaves ⑥ on its own record, which is right: `scenario-eval` does not describe the skills round.
- The two deleted lines lose no rule. 「问数基线 ② 的数字仍不对外」 is still implied by line 38's general ban, whose exception does not name ②; SKILL §5's pointer 「问数基线 ② 的数字仍不对外,见 `lanes/eval.md`」 therefore still resolves. The deleted second hand-over line repeated lines 7 and 12–15.
- Charter and SKILL agree on every point both state: ask mode only, the dataset cards, local boot, subscription login, no cloud repository, an `eval-run` per round.

`.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`, against README and the runner on `main`, and against #34911's own account of its change:

- §0: `assertSubscriptionLogin` (`driver.ts:211`) throws `ApiBillingRefusedError` when either variable is set, when no login is reported, or on an API-key method. Holds.
- §1 cards: `grep -l '"datasetQuestions"' docs/qa/scenarios/*.json` answers `order_to_cash` and `travel_expense` on `main`. One card per command holds: `withInstalledBuild` skips a template whose namespace is not the card's (`orchestrate.ts:1768`), and one command takes one `--template`.
- §1 cadence: `--ask-repeats N` repeats question turns only; operations run once (README, Repeats). Matches the card's 「one repetition a day and five weekly」.
- §1 start condition: stated as a condition the reader checks, with both carriers named, so it stays true after they land. Its reason (`capability` is runtime-uncreatable, so the unmanaged door answers `422 UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE`) matches #34911's body, and that PR falls back on this one code, in ask mode only.
- §2: `--ask-model` and `--ask-effort` exist and work without `--model` (README example). `summary` refuses a table whose runs differ in `ask skills` or `ask repeats` (`TABLE_DIMENSIONS`, `summary.ts`), so both 「拒并表」 claims hold.
- §4 example: every flag exists; ask mode with `--template` and no `scratch` is accepted; `--create-version` pins the blank host's scaffold; `--record` records ask turns (`card/ask/run/STEP/PERSONA`) and they replay. Each command has its own `--out`, so the per-date record file name does not collide.
- §5 record: `env.framework`, `env.packagesLine` (`scorecard.ts:941`) and the top-level `template` (file and sha256) exist as named. The three facts the card's Done-when asks of each daily record (runner sha, served model, package source) are all required by this bullet. `Run · datasets` is a scorecard row and `summary` has no column for it, as stated.
- §5 leak reading: personas are created with `role: 'user'` and ask through `/api/v1/mcp` on their own key (`app.ts:184`, `:235`); dataset questions are asked as the admin (`orchestrate.ts:1501`) and feed no leak tally (`scorecard.ts:341` counts question turns only). Holds, and it is the card's 「server-side reading」.
- Other modes: nothing existing is rewritten. The control-card, starter, template and replay rules are untouched, and the new entries are marked as the ask round's differences. Findings still route through §6.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; each may stay open):

- N1 (nit) — `lanes/eval.md` line 38 names 「场景卡与 ⑥」 while line 30 enumerates 「①⑤⑥」. ⑤'s records are scenario-card `eval-run` records (same cards, same runner, filed through `scenario-eval` §5, which says they carry full scores), so the line covers them; writing 「①⑤⑥」 there would say so outright and is shorter.
- N2 (nit) — `lanes/eval.md` line 18 writes `pnpm skill-evals` with the package in parentheses. The root `package.json` has no such script; the runnable form is `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals` (README). The parenthesis points the reader to the right package.
- N3 (nit) — SKILL §1 says the same build is reused across rounds but not where a card's verified build comes from or where it is kept between sessions. The file name and sha256 are in every record, so drift is visible. The seat post is the place for the path when the routine is armed.
- N4 (nit) — SKILL §1's start condition names the daily round only, and checks that the two PRs merged, not that the pinned runner sha contains them. The weekly ask round has the same dependency. A fresh checkout of `main` satisfies both.
- N5 (nit) — SKILL §5 writes `driver.askSkills`; in the record it sits at `env.driver.askSkills`, beside the `env.` paths the same bullet spells in full.
- N6 (nit) — the charter schedules ⑤ daily only; the five-repeat weekly ask round is stated in the SKILL alone. No contradiction: the SKILL is the procedure.

The card's Done-when (seven consecutive daily records) is not this slice's and is not claimed by it; the PR says `Part of`, with no closing verb.
